resources.string: Each group is off by default. When on, she only looks when the conversation needs it. Choose \"Let her always know\" to add one line of context to every chat. The data only goes to the model provider you set up.

The title, time and place of events in a time range she asks about (up to 31 days, 20 events). With your confirmation she can add events to your main calendar. If she always knows, she sees up to 3 of today\'s remaining events.
The time of your next alarm. With your confirmation, and only while the app is open, she can set alarms and timers in your clock app.
Only the name, phone numbers and birthday of up to 5 contacts that match a name she looks up. Contacts are never sent in bulk. With your confirmation she can open the dialer; you press call yourself.
Your approximate coordinates and city, and the weather there. Location is only read while the app is open; in the background she uses the last saved location. Weather comes from Open-Meteo.
Your sleep times and daily steps from Health Connect. If Health Connect has no steps, the phone\'s step counter is used as a backup.
The song, artist and app currently playing, and the last 50 songs. It uses notification access only to see media sessions and never reads notification content.
She checks only when the conversation is about it
One short line is added to every chat, such as today\'s steps
Approximate location is enough. Background location is never requested.
If you would rather not share your location, enter a city and the weather will use it.
No city with that name was found
Health Connect needs an update before it can be used.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. You can install it and come back. Steps can still come from the phone\'s step counter.

Starmate reads only your sleep sessions and step counts, and only when you have turned on the Health group. The numbers are sent, as part of a chat request, to the AI model provider you configured yourself, so your companion can ask how you slept or notice an active day. Starmate never writes health data, never shares it with anyone else and has no server of its own. You can turn the group off or revoke access in Health Connect at any time.
On Android 13 and later, if the switch is greyed out, allow restricted settings first.
Android 13 and later block notification access for apps installed outside an app store until you allow restricted settings. Starmate needs notification access only to see what music is playing.
Try turning on notification access for Starmate once. If it is greyed out, continue.
Tap the ⋮ menu in the top corner and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then confirm.
Go back to notification access and turn on Starmate music.
She knows your city and the weather there. Approximate location is enough.
She knows what is on your schedule today.
She knows how you slept and how much you walked.
She knows what song you are listening to.
